capabilities: Highlight, underline, or wavy-underline selected text in Reading View, Live Preview, and PDFs
List excerpts in a sidebar grouped by nearest heading with click-to-jump navigation
Filter excerpts by pen style and color
Export excerpts as copied Markdown or as new notes with source backlinks
Customize five palette colors, default pen, line thickness, highlight height, and opacity
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README says desktop is tested on macOS only; physical iOS/Android testing is still pending. Highlights live in the plugin's data.json, not in notes, so backing up or syncing that file is needed to preserve or share them. Optional companion theme and plugin (Animal Island Cozy, Animal Island Calendar) are mentioned but not required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in pen-style colored highlighting that works in notes and the PDF reader without editing the underlying Markdown, nor a way to collect and export marked passages.
summary: Text annotation plugin that highlights and underlines text in notes and PDFs, collects excerpts in a sidebar, and exports them as Markdown.
